title: Report a sensor reading
prompt: A sensor returns a `Reading`. Its boolean tag `ok` says whether it is a measurement or a failure. Write `display(reading: Reading): string`. For a measurement, return the degrees followed by `" C"`. For a failure, return its `message` exactly. Zero and negative degrees and an empty message are valid.
hints: Find the field present in both shapes.
The boolean tag tells you which payload exists even if its value is zero or empty.
In the measurement branch convert the number to text before appending the unit.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Replaces every failure message with one sample.

feedback: Branch on ok. Preserve the payload even when its number or text would be false in an if test.
